items.title: Where Ripple and Securitize fit into the GENIUS Act
kv: Enacted statute; core implementation remains proposed at this cutoff

GENIUS supplies the federal constitution for the payment-stablecoin cash leg. It reaches Ripple directly through RLUSD and Standard Custody's issuer obligation. It reaches Securitize mainly when a regulated security is funded, exchanged, settled, custodied or redeemed through a payment stablecoin.

GENIUS does not turn a tokenized fund share into money, authorize the underlying security, approve a blockchain, or merge the stablecoin issuer's ledger with the transfer agent's shareholder record. A named charter, current state approval or product integration is not by itself a GENIUS permitted-payment-stablecoin-issuer approval.

Title: One transaction, two regimes · Steps: The investor holds a security whose eligibility, title, transfer restrictions and servicing are governed by securities law, product documents and the appointed recordkeeper., Securitize validates the investor and reconciles the security-side instruction; the fund share must be cancelled, transferred or otherwise reflected on the authoritative shareholder record., RLUSD is delivered as a distinct payment-stablecoin claim against its issuing entity. GENIUS governs the issuer, reserves, redemption, compliance and holder-priority architecture once operative., If the holder later redeems RLUSD, the issuer-side process extinguishes or reconciles the token claim and pays eligible bank cash under the applicable terms. That bank-cash receipt is another record, not automatic proof from the on-chain transfer alone. · Reading: GENIUS standardizes the money object at the handoff. It does not standardize the security, replace Securitize's shareholder record or prove that every announced exchange completed all accounting and cash-settlement steps.

A final OCC or other primary-regulator implementing rule and the resulting 120-day effective-date calculation. · Certification of New York's regime and a public approval naming Standard Custody, Ripple National Trust Bank or another exact entity as a permitted payment stablecoin issuer. · Any product-level evidence that a Securitize-administered fund or tokenized instrument is actually held as an RLUSD reserve asset, rather than merely being exchangeable into RLUSD. · The exact Securitize affiliate and stablecoin used in production atomic settlement, including customer, custody, order-control and accounting records. · Final customer-identification, BSA, sanctions and lawful-order rules, plus actual implementation across the named issuer and service-provider entities.

items.title: Which object is inside GENIUS?
kv: RLUSD fits the payment-stablecoin definition because it is designed for payment or settlement and carries a fixed-dollar redemption obligation. XRP does not fit that definition merely because it can move value: it has no issuer obligation to redeem at a fixed monetary value.

BUIDL, VBILL, BRSRV/RSVXX and tokenized public-equity interests remain securities. The Act's definition excludes securities from payment stablecoins, even when the security has a dollar NAV or can be exchanged into a stablecoin.
GENIUS governs the RLUSD cash claim; securities law and the governing instrument continue to govern the fund share or equity claim.

items.title: Who must pass the issuer gate?
kv: Standard Custody & Trust Company is the disclosed RLUSD issuer and current NYDFS-chartered obligor. To issue under the federal regime it must fit an approved state-qualified or federal-qualified route. Ripple's brand, software licenses and preliminary national trust-bank approval do not substitute for approval of the exact issuing entity.

Securitize is generally transfer agent, broker-dealer/ATS, adviser, administrator or technology provider around securities issued by outside funds and companies. It does not become the RLUSD issuer by offering the exchange interface.
The entity owing the dollar redemption is the regulated center of the GENIUS analysis, not the chain, wallet, transfer agent or brand alone.

items.title: What backs the cash leg?
kv: A permitted issuer must maintain identifiable reserves at least one-for-one in the statutory categories and meet redemption, disclosure, custody and supervisory requirements. RLUSD's disclosed short-duration reserve design is directionally aligned, but regulator approval and exact final-rule conformance remain separate findings.

A tokenized Treasury or fund share is not automatically an eligible RLUSD reserve asset. The statute can admit a registered government money-market fund invested solely in eligible assets and tokenized versions of permitted reserves, but actual eligibility depends on the exact product, portfolio, legal ownership and regulator treatment.
BUIDL or BRSRV proximity to Treasuries does not prove that Standard Custody holds that instrument in RLUSD reserves. A product receipt is required.

items.title: Where can yield sit?
kv: GENIUS bars a permitted or qualifying foreign issuer from paying interest or yield solely for holding, using or retaining the payment stablecoin.

A separately constituted fund share can carry investment return because it is a security rather than the payment stablecoin. Exchanging RLUSD for a security, or a security for RLUSD, preserves two instruments and two claims.

Securitize can form a yield-bearing investment layer adjacent to a non-yielding stablecoin cash layer, but that is a legal separation—not evidence of an exemption, evasion route or automatic product approval.

items.title: Who can freeze or correct what?
kv: The stablecoin issuer must have the technical capability to comply with lawful orders that can require seizure, freezing, burning or prevention of transfer of identified payment stablecoins or accounts. BSA, sanctions, customer-identification and due-diligence duties also attach to the issuer framework.

An appointed transfer agent can freeze, claw back, burn, reissue or correct the security-side shareholder record under the governing instrument. That authority does not let it rewrite Standard Custody's stablecoin liability.
Stablecoin control and security-title correction are separate remedy systems even when one interface coordinates them.

items.title: How do the operating companies enter?
kv: Ripple Payments, Custody, Prime, Treasury or distribution entities can enter the analysis when an exact entity exchanges, transfers, safeguards, offers or sells a payment stablecoin for compensation. Their other products are not converted into stablecoin issuance merely because RLUSD is available inside the stack.

Securitize Markets or another exact affiliate can enter as a digital-asset service provider on the stablecoin funding, exchange, settlement or custody leg. The securities placement, ATS, transfer-agency and fund-administration legs retain their separate legal bases.
The 2028 provider gate will function like an asset-eligibility rule at covered U.S. intermediaries; application turns on the exact entity, activity, customer and coin.

items.title: What happens if one side fails?
kv: GENIUS creates reserve-asset and bankruptcy priorities for payment-stablecoin holders and distinguishes the issuer's redemption obligation from a wallet balance or market price.

The investor's rights in the fund or equity security continue to depend on the issuer, governing documents and controlling shareholder record. A corrected share register does not itself produce dollars; a successful stablecoin redemption does not itself restore the share.
A failed combined transaction must be diagnosed leg by leg: security title, stablecoin delivery, stablecoin issuer claim and bank-cash payout.

Their other products are not converted into stablecoin issuance merely because RLUSD is available inside the stack.

Securitize Markets or another exact affiliate can enter as a digital-asset service provider on the stablecoin funding, exchange, settlement or custody leg. The securities placement, ATS, transfer-agency and fund-administration legs retain their separate legal bases.
The 2028 provider gate will function like an asset-eligibility rule at covered U.S. intermediaries; application turns on the exact entity, activity, customer and coin.

record.title: What happens if one side fails?
fields: GENIUS creates reserve-asset and bankruptcy priorities for payment-stablecoin holders and distinguishes the issuer's redemption obligation from a wallet balance or market price.

The investor's rights in the fund or equity security continue to depend on the issuer, governing documents and controlling shareholder record. A corrected share register does not itself produce dollars; a successful stablecoin redemption does not itself restore the share.
A failed combined transaction must be diagnosed leg by leg: security title, stablecoin delivery, stablecoin issuer claim and bank-cash payout.

catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
catalog_context.answer: Of 20 crypto networks and companies we track, only one is used at scale and none is proven under stress; many brands rest on a handful of legal providers.
